literal.prompt: Какая стратегия Blizzard 1998 года противопоставила терранов, зергов и протоссов?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The Strong identifies StarCraft as Blizzard’s RTS, released March 1998, and names the three races and their conflict (L195-L200). Blizzard independently names Terran, Protoss and Zerg (L5-L6, L9-L39). The key is well supported. The other titles are from distinct genres/publishers; these alternatives can be eliminated from genre/publisher cues instead of recognizing the keyed fact, so comparability is held.
literalGroups.locator: The Strong L195-L200; Blizzard L5-L6, L9-L39.

literalGroups.primaryGround: The Strong dates StarCraft to March 1998 (L195) and describes it as the leading esports title of its time (L202). The revised explanation names the correct answer directly.
